name: Masked Headline
intent: Establish immediate typographic hierarchy on load by revealing headlines line-by-line from baseline without full-page layout shift.
useCase: Hero section display typography (h1) capped at two lines.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Headlines render instantly in place without transform or delay.

performanceConsiderations: Uses transform: translateY and overflow: hidden parent; GPU accelerated, zero layout reflow.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Reset will-change and clear inline transforms upon animation completion.

responsiveBehavior: Preserved across desktop and mobile viewports with responsive font size clamp.

name: Shutter Image
intent: Draw focus to the single hero or showcase image by opening an aperture clip-path while settling scale.
useCase: Single focal hero image or primary product showcase.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Clip-path set to inset(0) and scale(1) immediately.

performanceConsiderations: Requires composited clip-path and transform scale; fetchpriority=high on image.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Remove clip-path once fully opened to allow natural image overlays or tooltips.

responsiveBehavior: Maintains aspect ratio; clip-path opens vertically on narrow screens.

name: Scaling Wordmark
intent: Communicate weight and architectural presence by subtly scaling the brand mark on initial scroll.
useCase: Monumental headers or footers in editorial or branding sites.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Wordmark stays at fixed 1.0 scale without scroll translation.

performanceConsiderations: Transform scale only; travel kept strictly under 8% to avoid blurring.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Disconnect scroll listener or ViewTimeline on component unmount.

responsiveBehavior: Disabled on screens < 600px width; wordmark scales with clamp() instead.

name: Pinned Story
intent: Enable focused linear reading by holding context sticky while items or narrative steps scroll alongside.
useCase: Case studies, product walkthroughs, stepped explanations (max 3 steps).

reducedMotionFallback.description: Sticky positioning converts to static block layout with standard spacing.

performanceConsiderations: Pure CSS position: sticky with minimal layout disruption; no scroll hijacking.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Reset sticky offsets if parent container dimensions change.

responsiveBehavior: Unpins on mobile devices (<768px); displays as sequential vertical cards.

name: Index with Preview
intent: Provide instant visual feedback on table/list hover without navigating away.
useCase: Work galleries, archives, case study indexes, portfolio rows.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Preview shows inline statically without pointer-following momentum.

performanceConsiderations: Uses requestAnimationFrame for pointer tracking; GPU accelerated opacity & transform.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Remove mousemove listeners on pointerleave and destroy.

responsiveBehavior: Converts to static inline thumbnails on touch/mobile devices.

name: Curtain Footer
intent: Unveil final call-to-action or footer naturally as the page content slides up like an architectural curtain.
useCase: Editorial and marketing landing pages closing screen.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Footer is static block element below main content without layering.

performanceConsiderations: Zero JavaScript required; CSS sticky + z-index stacking context.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Ensure z-index and background opacity are maintained.

responsiveBehavior: Preserved on all screen sizes; background of main must remain 100% opaque.

name: Slow Crossfade
intent: Evoke quiet editorial atmosphere through subtle photographic transition resembling changing room light.
useCase: Ambient heroes, art museum showcases, hospitality hero backgrounds.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Display only the primary photo statically with no cycle or crossfade.

performanceConsiderations: Pause timer when document.hidden is true (visibilitychange API); low CPU overhead.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Clear crossfade setInterval and visibility listeners on teardown.

name: Edge-to-Edge Marquee
intent: Provide subtle kinetic rhythm between distinct sections using slow linear typography travel.
useCase: Section dividers, client/partner lists, single brand statements.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Marquee freezes in place; content renders as static horizontal flex list.

performanceConsiderations: Transform: translateX with will-change; duplicated items for gapless looping.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Pause on hover and disconnect requestAnimationFrame on component unmount.

responsiveBehavior: Adjust speed slightly on smaller viewports to prevent excessive velocity.

name: Drag Row
intent: Enable intuitive, native touch and drag exploration of wide content collections.
useCase: Card carousels, horizontal image galleries, multi-item showcases.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Native scroll-snap-type: x mandatory with scrollbar visible.

performanceConsiderations: Uses native CSS scroll-snap; zero third-party carousel JS overhead.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: No complex lifecycle; native browser scroll container.

responsiveBehavior: Natural mobile touch swipe; snap align start.

name: Colour by Chapter
intent: Signal narrative chapter transitions by transitioning section background and fixed navigation ink.
useCase: Long-form editorial, product chapters, case studies.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Colors switch immediately on section threshold without smooth transition.

performanceConsiderations: Color and background-color transitions on fixed elements only; no full-body repaints.
responsiveBehavior: Full functionality on both mobile and desktop viewports.

name: Stillness (Intentional Restraint)
intent: Maximize clarity, respect reader attention, and communicate rigorous authority by deliberately abstaining from ambient or entrance animations.
useCase: Financial platforms, dense data applications, technical documentation, minimal luxury.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Native stillness matches reduced motion perfectly.

performanceConsiderations: Maximum performance: zero RAF loops, zero animation overhead, instant LCP.
responsiveBehavior: Consistently static across all form factors.

name: Opening Window
intent: Dramatize handoff between typographic thesis and primary photographic evidence as window expands to full bleed.
useCase: Hero handoffs, key product reveals, architectural portfolio entries.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Image renders directly as full-width element without scroll expansion.

performanceConsiderations: Bound to scroll progression; clip-path and scale transformations.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Reset transforms and unobserve scroll thresholds upon teardown.

responsiveBehavior: Simplified to static full-bleed figure on screens < 768px.

name: Ink Fill Statement
intent: Establish deliberate reading cadence for core thesis statements by increasing text ink opacity on scroll.
useCase: Single manifesto statements, mission paragraphs, key quote moments.

reducedMotionFallback.description: All text renders at 100% ink opacity immediately.

performanceConsiderations: Opacity transition only; words remain legible even at baseline 45% ink.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Disconnect scroll-bound timeline once all text reaches 1.0 opacity.

responsiveBehavior: Fully accessible and legible on mobile; no layout disruption.

name: Sheet Over a Held Picture
intent: Turn chapters like physical pages by sliding an opaque content sheet over a held background figure.
useCase: Editorial essays, visual monographs, full-bleed transition sections.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Picture unpins and scrolls as standard block element.

performanceConsiderations: Sticky positioning on 100svh figure; zero layout thrashing.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Maintain relative stacking context in CSS.

responsiveBehavior: Height clamped to mobile svh; caption remains visible at all times.

name: Sideways Gallery
intent: Present horizontal collections (<= 8 items) without losing vertical scroll momentum.
useCase: Curated architectural rooms, product finishes, team leadership showcases.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Switches to native drag-row with snapping.

performanceConsiderations: Restricted to <=8 items; hardware accelerated translateX.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Remove wheel/scroll bindings on mobile resize or destroy.

responsiveBehavior: Strictly transforms into touch drag-row on viewports < 1024px.

name: Pushed Line
intent: Add physical inertia to a single monumental line of text locked to the scrollbar.
useCase: Single large brand claim (max 1 per page) between sections.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Text sits centered at translateX(0) statically.

performanceConsiderations: Locked between -12% and +12% translation; words must never be cropped.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Reset translation when out of view.

responsiveBehavior: Travel reduced to +-5% on mobile to maintain viewport bounds.

name: Rolling Figures
intent: Emphasize quantitative achievements by rolling metric digits up to target value on scroll into view.
useCase: Key metrics, founding years, performance figures, financial statistics.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Numbers render target numerical value statically.

performanceConsiderations: Runs once per page load via IntersectionObserver; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Unobserve target once rolled; never continuously animate numbers.

name: Carried Picture
intent: Provide seamless spatial continuity between index lists and detail pages using view transitions.
useCase: Index-to-detail navigation, work portfolio items, product cards.

reducedMotionFallback.description: Standard instant page navigation without morph transition.

performanceConsiderations: Native browser document.startViewTransition API; zero library dependency.

lifecycle.cleanupRequirements: Ensure view-transition-name is unique and cleared after navigation.

responsiveBehavior: Supported across all browsers that implement View Transitions.
